sub_graphs.title: EIP-7723: Network Upgrade Inclusion Lifecycle
sub_graphs.description: Models the state transitions of an EIP through the network upgrade inclusion process

nodes.label: EIP in Draft Status
nodes.description: EIP exists but has not been proposed for any network upgrade

nodes.label: Submit PR to Upgrade Meta EIP
nodes.description: Proposer creates pull request to add EIP to network upgrade

nodes.label: Proposed for Inclusion
nodes.description: EIP has been proposed but not yet reviewed by developers

nodes.label: Developer Review
nodes.description: Core developers review EIP in context of upgrade

nodes.label: Considered for Inclusion
nodes.description: Positive developer sentiment, implementation may proceed

nodes.label: Implement Python Specification
nodes.description: Create implementation in execution-specs repository with tests

nodes.label: Implement in Upgrade Devnet
nodes.description: Include EIP in next upgrade devnet for testing

nodes.label: Scheduled for Inclusion
nodes.description: Active implementation and testing underway

nodes.label: Declined for Inclusion
nodes.description: EIP excluded from current upgrade cycle

nodes.label: Activate Network Fork
nodes.description: Network upgrade goes live on mainnet

nodes.label: Included
nodes.description: EIP is active on mainnet post-fork

external_entities.name: EIP Proposer

external_entities.name: Core Developers

external_entities.name: Client Implementation Teams
external_entities.description: Teams implementing EIP in their client software

ambiguities.text: The phrase 'positive developer sentiment' is subjective and lacks precise definition.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume positive sentiment means no blocking objections from client team leads during AllCoreDevs calls.

ambiguities.text: The specification does not define the process for resolving disputes about EIP inclusion.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume existing Ethereum governance norms apply: rough consensus on AllCoreDevs calls with final say by client team maintainers.

ambiguities.text: The term 'may proceed without' Python implementation is ambiguous about when this exception applies.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume this applies to EIPs with minimal execution layer changes or EIPs affecting only consensus layer.

implicit_assumptions.description: Assumes EIP proposers will actively maintain their proposals and respond to feedback.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Abandoned EIPs could block upgrade progress if they reach 'Scheduled' state.

implicit_assumptions.description: Assumes sufficient testing infrastructure exists to run upgrade devnets.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Inadequate testing could allow bugs to reach mainnet.

implicit_assumptions.description: Assumes community accepts EIP-7723 process as authoritative for upgrade decisions.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Contentious upgrades could bypass or ignore the formal process.
